gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-002 identifies the exact normalization defect in the local-boundedness proof: stationarity should be divided by the diverging original multiplier norm, whereas the displayed equation divides by the normalized pair, whose norm is one. It correctly explains that the right-hand side therefore need not converge to zero, so the limiting equation and MFCQ contradiction are unsupported, and it supplies the specific denominator correction and resulting limit argument.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both entries diagnose the same failed stationarity normalization in the proof of the primal-dual local-boundedness proposition: replacing the original multiplier norm by the unit norm of the normalized multipliers prevents bounded v_k from forcing the right-hand side to zero, invalidating the subsequent MFCQ contradiction until the denominator is corrected.
